details:
First of all, amazing job! The amount of work put into that is overwhelming!
Now for feedback and suggestions:
Add AFK icon next to the name plate (like the friend icon) - When using the AFK animation you can't necessarily know if it is the AFK animation or another animation. With AFK icon you can surely know that they are AFK.
Auto AFK on Desktop - Add a feature to auto AFK after a certain amount of time of no key or mouse input.
The "Gestures" section should be moved to config, or another less noticeable location - It is not used as much as the other features and I think it will be better to move it to make place for other more used features.
Other suggestions regrading Desktop Mode interactions:
Could be a good chance to improve Desktop Mode interactions with Avatar 3.0:
Ability to click buttons while holding an object and/or pick a second object simultaneously like in VR Mode - A lot of times I find myself in a situation when I need to drop the object I'm holding to be able to click a button. Also the limitation of Desktop Mode to certain features requires holding 2 objects at the same time. Could be helpful to be able to do that!
The ability to rotate a picked up object while holding a certain key - In Desktop Mode it is very difficult to rotate an object, it requires you to pick up and drop the object in order to rotate it and there's no easy way to rotate items like in VR Mode.
It could be useful to be able to rotate an object while holding a certain key, which disables looking around with the mouse and instead rotate the object.
For example: while holding "T", you can rotate the object with the mouse and when you release it, you can look around again.
That was a bit long lol but I hope you will take any of these suggestions and use them!
Thanks!
title: [FEEDBACK] Red AFK icon next to the name plate when AFK and more suggestions
